items.blocked: Current reference lookup is not event-time as-of table lookup or generally versioned dynamic refresh.
Watermark-bounded inner interval match with inclusive bound; inputs are insert-only, rows at or behind the common watermark are dropped. No general outer/retracting/distributed join.
Keeps the first row per key until event-time TTL expires at the common watermark. Not an unbounded/global deduplication guarantee.
Native CDC row/time options group complete source transactions; general Package trigger/scheduling is not this capability.
Bounded queue/working/spill quotas and node limits are not a general source rate governor.

Keyed tumbling/sliding count, sum and average may emit insert/update/delete (update/delete include the before image as applicable) changes with checkpointed published state; session remains final-only. No generic CDC retractions.
response/idempotent/receipt modes use one Native path; unknown commit is not safe blind replay. Includes local fixture source, not external endpoint crash/replay evidence.
Real MinIO staging and resume verified. Maintenance, arbitrary partition creation and Windows remain outside this evidence.
PostgreSQL TLS CDC insert, Kafka refund/duplicate, current MySQL lookup, SQL/Trino net 70 and same-ID resume with one snapshot; not production-wide mutable CDC or distributed exactly-once.

decisions: Management has no authentication and RunDispatcher persists request parameter JSON; all product execution/inspection must cross one scoped Worker entry
Native already owns Catalog, Journal, transactions, epochs and bulk transports; these remain the owners
Compute supports richer reports than profile.statistics exposes; Avro named references and reader resolution are absent in the baseline

PR #7 continuation: verified main remains 203c9c9f. Display-name rebinding cannot prove rename versus drop/re-add; SQL Server ODBC has an official XA request ABI independent of SQLGetXaSwitch exports; RunDispatcher process-local dictionaries cannot arbitrate multiple managers.
Authentication produces tenant/subject/resource grants; the same scope reaches Native Connection Manager authorization
Catalog stores opaque immutable parameter references; only an authorized Worker resolves encrypted values
Managed descriptors project Native dynamic ports, plans, errors, replay-safe flags, controls and confirmations; Native retains callback owners and sealed batches

Continuation contracts: physical provider identity is distinct from Package logical identity and lineage, with resource scope independent of Package. Native Schema/JSON/Wire/Arrow own the projection. Native Catalog owns CAS, durable fencing generations and pool ceilings; C# and JNI only project these. Microsoft XACALLPARAM goes directly through the current ODBC participant API and Native Journal coordinator.
A Worker cannot start business execution before the service records its Native identity; unknown outcomes require recovery
Source row counters join the epoch manifest so automatic Row Identity survives restart
Control events are notified at Native aligned boundaries without managed forwarding; state snapshots use Native Wire/Journal
Untrusted modules require Linux OS namespace/cgroup isolation; missing infrastructure refuses execution; Windows sandbox acceptance remains blocked
Remote CI billing limits and unavailable independent resources never become Passed

Continuation crash review: write the SQL Server receipt inside the XA branch before business DML; XA recovery plus digest-matching receipts prove outcomes, and prepared branches survive close. A lost Worker lease fences further Catalog writes and cancels its process; an expired Running record becomes RecoveryRequired without automatic side-effect replay. Wire layout revision 2 and checkpoint revision 3 explicitly refuse old recovery payloads. Cross-machine agents and structural state rebinding are still code gaps, not environment blocks.

Two-manager kill acceptance found private Worker execution/event records can lead the management index. Worker protocol revision 2 now transfers bounded canonical Native Catalog pages, continues from durable Native revisions/sequences, and rejects legacy requests; the host cannot relabel an unresolved resume as an ordinary preflight failure. The strengthened test verifies the resumed Native terminal record, not only the product status.
